---

### Product Type Guide

🔴 **Tier 1 (Real-time):** Fraud Detection Engine, Transaction Risk Scoring, Payments Settlement — latency SLI critical

🟡 **Tier 1 (Near-RT):** Customer 360, Account Aggregation, Treasury Liquidity — freshness + availability

🟢 **Tier 2 (Batch):** AML Monitoring, Credit Risk Models, Investment Analytics — freshness SLI primary

---

### SLO Thresholds Reference

Availability: target ≥ 99.9% | warn <99.9% | crit <80%

Error Rate: target <2% | warn >2% | crit >10%

Latency P95: target <200ms | warn >200ms | crit >500ms

Freshness: varies per product (RT: 300s / Batch: 86400s)

SLO Compliance: target ≥ 99.9% | breach <99%
